1.0 The Single $30 Capital Entry Paradigm

The Equora Community Matrix is engineered to eliminate financial barriers and eradicate predatory capital calls. Unlike conventional platforms that compel participants to continually inject fresh out-of-pocket funds to upgrade levels, Equora enforces a strictly one-time capital entry of $30.00 USD.

Direct manual purchases of higher slots (Slots 2 through 12) are prohibited at the smart contract level (require(slot == 1)). All upward advancement across the 12-slot ladder is financed 100% autonomously through internal matrix yield generated by Nodes P4 and P5.

2.0 The 10-Step Participant Lifecycle

From wallet connection to recurring matrix cashflow, the participant journey operates through ten deterministic steps:

  1. Web3 Wallet Connection: Connect Trobsafe or any compatible non-custodial Web3 wallet. Zero email, password, or KYC credentials required.
  2. Referral Lineage Binding: Enter the 5-digit referral code of your sponsor. The cryptographic bond is written permanently to EquoraRegistry.sol on Trobium.
  3. Slot 1 Activation ($30): Authorize and deposit exactly $30.00 USD in live TROB Coin. This represents the only personal capital you will ever deposit.
  4. Matrix Node Placement: The smart contract positions your Root Node 0 within your sponsor's active 14-node binary tree.
  5. Upline Pass-Up (P1 & P2): Positions 1 and 2 pass up $60 ($30 each) to qualify direct upline sponsors and expand network depth.
  6. Break-Even Cash Fill (P3): Position 3 triggers an instant push payout of $30.00 USD directly to your personal wallet, achieving 100% capital recovery.
  7. Autonomous Upgrade & Pools (P4 & P5): Positions 4 and 5 route $60 total to the 4 Protocol Pools via EquoraVault. In the exact same block, the contract unlocks Slot 2 ($60 value) with $0 out-of-pocket capital!
  8. Direct Cash Fills (P6, P8, P9, P11, P12): Receive an additional $150.00 USD pushed directly to your wallet ($30 × 5 nodes), bringing net cycle cash to $180.00 (600% ROI).
  9. Team Spillover Injection (P7, P10, P13): Three node fills ($90.00 total) flow directly to downline team members, accelerating overall team velocity.
  10. Matrix Board Recycle (P14): Position 14 recycles your matrix board into a fresh Cycle 2, while routing $30 to the 4 Protocol Pools.
